dimensions.subjectKeyDescription: Stable goal topics such as daily-budget, morning-budget, afternoon-budget and evening-budget.
dimensions.description: Explicitly confirmed long-term study minutes, group budgets, and changes to the future default with an effective date.

dimensions.subjectKeyDescription: Stable preference topics such as algorithm-mix, task-priority, rest-pattern and feedback-style.
dimensions.description: Only preferences the user explicitly confirmed; model suggestions that were not accepted do not belong here.

dimensions.subjectKeyDescription: Business date plus task key, for example 2026-10-20/12306.
dimensions.description: User-reported used task-window minutes, reported focus minutes with their stated scope, task output, partial work, and interruptions.

dimensions.subjectKeyDescription: Business date plus feedback topic, for example 2026-10-20/fatigue.
dimensions.description: Explicit user statements of fatigue, inability to continue, rest, or recovery; never an inferred personality or diagnosis.

dimensions.subjectKeyDescription: Business date plus adjustment topic, for example 2026-10-20/remaining-halved or daily-budget-from-2026-10-21.
dimensions.description: Day-scoped adjustments, recoveries, and long-term changes the user explicitly accepted, including their effective scope.

recordWhen: The user explicitly reports used task-window minutes or focus minutes and states which measure they mean.
The user explicitly reports that a planned task was completed, partially completed, blocked, cancelled, or not started.
The user explicitly says they are tired, cannot continue after a rest, stopped for the day, or have recovered.
The user explicitly confirms or changes a day budget, a long-term daily goal, or a group budget.
The user explicitly confirms a split, priority, rest pattern, or feedback preference.
The user explicitly corrects an earlier report about time, dates, completion, or load.
doNotRecordWhen: The model proposed a split, order, duration, priority, or rest pattern and the user has not accepted it.
A task was only planned, assigned, listed, or explained by the model.
The model infers mastery, ability, discipline, personality, illness, or long-term capacity from time spent or one fatigue report.
The observation is copied from a synthetic example, a test fixture, or another user's material.
The fact belongs to algorithm, interview, resume-knowledge, or backend-project-learning evidence.
A real-interview profile change has not been confirmed under the review Skill's own rule.
evidencePolicy.sourceRefPolicy: Use a locator that can be checked in the current environment, such as a conversation date and turn identifier or a platform message identifier. If no verifiable locator exists, keep the content in the current plan and report that the remote record lacks a source reference; never invent one.
